mapper.select: SELECT stock_id, name, category, publication_price, publication_amount, publication_balance, description, status FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN content = '매수' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state = '체결'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (content, state, price, amount, student_id, stock_id, created_date) VALUES (#{content}, #{state}, #{price}, #{amount}, #{studentId}, #{stockId}, NOW())
